phase: 6 - pinning down the refusal semantics on the host
where: host only; the phone was not touched
what_this_fixes: Trial749 poisoned the lease on any write failure without asking whether the command had been issued. On the phone that made the loader guard refuse to take ownership back, twice, each needing a manual fastboot.

new_assertions.name: refused outside the window, and never poisoned
new_assertions.covers: six addresses: container superblock, inside the container, the container's last block, the first log block, the partition's last block, far past the partition
new_assertions.checks: refused, zero rings, state != UR_POISONED, US_POISON_BIT clear

new_assertions.name: a refused write leaves the lease usable
new_assertions.covers: a device deliberately left not-idle so the request cannot go out

host_model_fixes: the stub asserted upiu[16] == 0x28, so the first WRITE(10) aborted it; it now recognises both shapes strictly
a write branch checks one block inside 608448..653559, placed before the chain branches because a write address (608456) falls inside the range those accept
not_achieved: a successful write end to end on the host: the polling loop ran the full 500000 iterations with completions=500000 but completed=0, cause not found
the case where a command is issued and then fails to restore, which is the one where poisoning is correct
phone: untouched this round; boot_a remains the byte-equal stock image
